producer_summary.definition: occupied = ligand COM (protein frame) within 6 A of crystal PC centroid AND >=1 pocket residue heavy atom within 4.5 A

summary.method: MDTraj make_whole + protein-anchor image_molecules in nm; backbone Kabsch fit applied to ligand; minimized reference identically imaged; crystal PC centroid transformed by crystal-to-reference backbone fit; heavy contacts <=4.5 A using periodic distances; 6 A center AND >=1 catalytic contact occupancy
